name: speechSynthesis voice list
plain: Lists the text-to-speech voices installed on the device.
meaning: Voices reveal OS, installed languages, downloaded premium voices and Google or Microsoft cloud voices, which hints at language and accessibility use.

steps: Call getVoices (may be empty until voiceschanged fires)

limits.headline: Can list the spoken voices installed on your device
limits.user_action: Nothing. It happens when the page loads, or when a page offers to speak text
can: List the text to speech voices on your device
Learn your system, languages and any extra voices you downloaded
Guess if you use accessibility tools
Speak text on the page when it chooses to
cannot: Listen to you or record sound
See what you say out loud
List voices in browsers that hide them

story.what_it_is: A page lists the text to speech voices installed on your device.

marketing.name: SpeechSynthesis
marketing.pitch: Lets a page read text aloud using voices that come with your device.

story.for_you: You do not see a prompt. The list of voices differs by system, language and add ons, so it reveals your language setup. If a site reads text aloud, it uses one of those voices.
story.for_makers: Reading apps and language tools need it to offer a voice. The list is also unique by phone, laptop and region, so tracking tools add it to a device ID.

use_cases.example: A language learning site reads a word aloud in the right accent so you can hear how it sounds.
A reading tool in the browser reads an article aloud for someone who has trouble seeing.
A news site adds a Listen to this article button that uses your device voice.
A browser game with voice narration picks a built in voice so it does not have to download audio.
A children's story site reads a book aloud with a friendly voice from the device.
A tracker adds the voice list to a device ID, since it differs by system and language packs.
A fraud tool sees a device with no voices, which is common for servers and headless browsers.

technical_bounds: Chrome on Android returns few voices

history.change: Voice list restricted for known fingerprinting scripts
